receipt_voids_tendered_together.name: receipt_voids_tendered_together
receipt_voids_tendered_together.value:
("receipt_voids"."tendered_currency" IS NULL AND "receipt_voids"."tendered_amount" IS NULL AND "receipt_voids"."exchange_rate" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipt_voids"."tendered_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_voids"."tendered_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_voids"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL)

receipt_voids_exchange_rate_id_tendered.name: receipt_voids_exchange_rate_id_tendered
receipt_voids_exchange_rate_id_tendered.value: "receipt_voids"."exchange_rate_id" IS NULL OR "receipt_voids"."tendered_currency" IS NOT NULL

receipts_target_check.name: receipts_target_check
receipts_target_check.value:
("receipts"."target"::text = 'sale' AND "receipts"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."order_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipts"."target"::text = 'order' AND "receipts"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."sale_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipts"."target"::text = 'account' AND "receipts"."client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."sale_id" IS NULL AND "receipts"."order_id" IS NULL)

receipts_tendered_together.name: receipts_tendered_together
receipts_tendered_together.value:
("receipts"."tendered_currency" IS NULL AND "receipts"."tendered_amount" IS NULL AND "receipts"."exchange_rate" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipts"."tendered_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."tendered_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL)

receipts_exchange_rate_id_tendered.name: receipts_exchange_rate_id_tendered
receipts_exchange_rate_id_tendered.value: "receipts"."exchange_rate_id" IS NULL OR "receipts"."tendered_currency" IS NOT NULL

refunds_target_check.name: refunds_target_check
refunds_target_check.value:
("refunds"."target" = 'account' AND "refunds"."client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."sale_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("refunds"."target" = 'sale' AND "refunds"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."client_id" IS NULL)

supplier_payments_target_check.name: supplier_payments_target_check
supplier_payments_target_check.value:
("supplier_payments"."target" = 'goods_receipt' AND "supplier_payments"."goods_receipt_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("supplier_payments"."target" = 'account' AND "supplier_payments"."goods_receipt_id" IS NULL)

products_dimensions_together.name: products_dimensions_together
products_dimensions_together.value: ("products"."length_cm" is null and "products"."width_cm" is null and "products"."height_cm" is null) or ("products"."length_cm" is not null and "products"."width_cm" is not null and "products"."height_cm" is not null)

conversation_notes_body_text_valid.name: conversation_notes_body_text_valid
conversation_notes_body_text_valid.value: "conversation_notes"."body_text" IS NULL OR ("conversation_notes"."body_text" = btrim("conversation_notes"."body_text") AND char_length("conversation_notes"."body_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)

clients_email_format.name: clients_email_format
clients_email_format.value: "clients"."email" = lower("clients"."email") and char_length("clients"."email") <= 254 and position('@' in "clients"."email") > 1

ingestion_events_identity_not_blank.name: ingestion_events_identity_not_blank
ingestion_events_identity_not_blank.value: btrim("ingestion_events"."source") <> '' AND btrim("ingestion_events"."external_ref") <> '' AND btrim("ingestion_events"."event_type") <> '' AND btrim("ingestion_events"."payload_hash") <> ''

business_hour_exceptions_slot_2_after_1.name: business_hour_exceptions_slot_2_after_1
business_hour_exceptions_slot_2_after_1.value: "business_hour_exceptions"."opens_2" is null or ("business_hour_exceptions"."opens_1" is not null and "business_hour_exceptions"."opens_2" > "business_hour_exceptions"."closes_1")

business_hour_exceptions_whole_minutes.name: business_hour_exceptions_whole_minutes
business_hour_exceptions_whole_minutes.value: extract(second from "business_hour_exceptions"."opens_1") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hour_exceptions"."closes_1") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hour_exceptions"."opens_2") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hour_exceptions"."closes_2") = 0

business_hours_slot_2_after_1.name: business_hours_slot_2_after_1
business_hours_slot_2_after_1.value: "business_hours"."opens_2" is null or ("business_hours"."opens_1" is not null and "business_hours"."opens_2" > "business_hours"."closes_1")

business_hours_whole_minutes.name: business_hours_whole_minutes
business_hours_whole_minutes.value: extract(second from "business_hours"."opens_1") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hours"."closes_1") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hours"."opens_2") = 0 and extract(second from "business_hours"."closes_2") = 0

orders_status_dates.name: orders_status_dates
orders_status_dates.value:
("orders"."delivered_at" is not null) = ("orders"."status" = 'delivered')
        and ("orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled')
        and ("orders"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'delivered') or "orders"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."status" <> 'pending' or "orders"."confirmed_at" is null)

purchase_orders_status_dates.name: purchase_orders_status_dates
purchase_orders_status_dates.value:
("purchase_orders"."closed_at" is not null) = ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'closed')
        and ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'cancelled')

suppliers_email_format.name: suppliers_email_format
suppliers_email_format.value: "suppliers"."email" = lower("suppliers"."email") and char_length("suppliers"."email") <= 254 and position('@' in "suppliers"."email") > 1

sales_order_has_client.name: sales_order_has_client
sales_order_has_client.value: "sales"."order_id" IS NULL OR "sales"."client_id" IS NOT NULL

sales_replaces_needs_order.name: sales_replaces_needs_order
sales_replaces_needs_order.value: "sales"."replaces_sale_id" IS NULL OR "sales"."order_id" IS NOT NULL
